butt_rock.label: Butt-Rock Risk
butt_rock.description: Likelihood of drifting into post-grunge, radio hard rock, macho chorus delivery, or overproduced hard-rock vocals.

club_drift.label: Club Drift Risk
club_drift.description: Likelihood of drifting into club, EDM, dance-pop, or festival-style production when that is not intended.

genre_drift.label: Genre Drift Risk
genre_drift.description: Likelihood that the generated song drifts away from the selected genre identity.

harsh_vocals.label: Harsh Vocal Risk
harsh_vocals.description: Likelihood of screamed, growled, shrieked, or abrasive vocal output.

reverb.label: Reverb Risk
reverb.description: Likelihood of huge, washed-out, distant, or cavernous vocal/production space.

synthetic_overload.label: Synthetic Overload Risk
synthetic_overload.description: Likelihood of excessive synth processing, robotic texture, EDM effects, or over-digital production.

vocal_grunts.label: Grunt Risk
vocal_grunts.description: Likelihood of random growls, macho adlibs, barking vocals, or aggressive vocal artifacts.
